# Versioned synthetic corpus

`v1/manifest.json` pins every native-format source file and its reviewed
session-migrate revision. The four `basic` fixtures are copied unchanged from
MIT-licensed synthetic upstream fixtures. Complete notice:
`../support/LICENSE.session-migrate` (copyright 2026 xhluca).
`v1/scenarios.json` contains explicitly harness-neutral discovery/lifecycle
and failure scenarios; it does not invent OpenCode plugin events or prove
hook execution. Runtime-specific raw lifecycle payload fixtures will be added
only after the corresponding adapter verifies its interface.

All text, images, tools, IDs and paths are synthetic. No user session or auth
store is a fixture. `support.fixtures.materialize` validates a manifest hash,
copies into the test's private directories, and refuses overwrite. Modify only
copies; retain original bytes for source-immutability assertions.

OpenCode 2.0.23 is generated by the pinned upstream writer from the Codex basic
fixture, with a fixed timestamp, cwd, model and UUID sequence. The Pi branch
fixture adds a synthetic compaction, inactive sibling and active continuation.
All six native files were independently reparsed with the reviewed upstream
readers during AS-017; this is not native client load/resume proof. Parser and
all-route tests must exercise actual product adapters as they are implemented.
